text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...Three years of taking on challenges 
alongside Lucky Lilac. Colored by the 
changing seasons and blooming flowers, our 
journey came to a close."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And now—

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Now, rounding the 4th corner into the 
final straight!! Lucky Lilac from the 
inside!! Here comes Lucky Lilac!!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
And coming from the outside is Almond 
Eye!! It's down to these two, just as 
expected!!! Lucky Lilac on the inside, 
Almond Eye on the outside!

text_block_list.name: Ruck & Eye
text_block_list.text: —Haaaaaaaahhh!!!!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Lucky Lilac!! Almond Eye!! Who took the 
win—!!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOOOOOOOH!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Race Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Gaaaaah!! That was another insane race!! 
Any race with Almond Eye and Lucky Lilac 
running together is guaranteed to be a 
banger!!

text_block_list.name: Race Fan B
text_block_list.text:
"I really love Lucky Lilac. Standing 
alongside a superstar like Eye, competing 
with her, and staying a 'queen' the whole 
time... she's so cool!"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
They're both just so consistently strong, 
it's unbelievable...! Neither of them 
shows an opening—

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
They certainly won't yield the era easily, 
will they? Yet that is precisely why... 
those two will become legends—

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
How 'bout you finally take a break? The 
younger generation's startin' to see us as 
a thorn in their side, y'know.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Because Lara keeps getting stronger and 
stronger! I don't have time to take a 
break!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Can't be helped, right? I'm the only one 
who can keep up with Ai-san's limitless 
spending.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Then I guess that makes us even.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
...How many times have we reached this 
exact same conclusion?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"Will you compete with me again... in our 
next race?"

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Of course. After all, our place is――

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Because I'm the unbeatable tsukkomi 
"queen."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: ...Their journey continues.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The racing world, where petals flutter and 
light streaks across the turf, will 
continue to be painted in vibrant colors. 
By countless legendary battles, by 
timeless legends—!!!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The Story of the Straight-Man Queen: Lucky 
Lilac ~Fin~

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Wait, why the heck are you ending it on 
your own?!
choice_data_list:
Huh!? What happened to the ending we just 
had!?

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Hey, I'm not done talkin' yet. Why're you 
tryin' to wrap things up all smoothly by 
yourself?
choice_data_list: I'm aiming for the record, so...

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Ah, come to think of it, you did mention 
that at the beginning—wait, seriously, now 
of all times?! You still haven't given up 
on that?!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
......*Ahem*. Well, so that is how it 
stands—

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
And that's how I've managed to keep going 
as "the Queen," still competing with 
Ai-san all this time.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
My dream of becoming the star of the 
racing world... I suppose I'm still 
striving toward it even now.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Stop tryin' to wrap up the show already!! 
We don't need the end credits rolling to 
Umapyoi Densetsu!!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
...What? You wanna wrap this up that fast? 
You sick of doing comedy with me already?
choice_data_list: It's just about time for training.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Are you for real?! Though I guess that's 
the best thing about ya!!
choice_data_list:
Truth is, I'd love to do more comedy 
routines with you, though.

Truth is, I'd love to do more comedy 
routines with you, though.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Still talkin' smack right to the very 
end~~~~~~!! That's enough outta you!!!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Thank you very much~.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Pheeew~~~~...! Threw in so many retorts.
choice_data_list:
That was like three years' worth of 
retorts all at once, huh.

That was like three years' worth of 
retorts all at once, wasn't it.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, we were reminiscing, and then out of 
nowhere she was like, 'Wanna do a stand-up 
routine?'—

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. I never thought we'd go all the way 
from our first meeting to this milestone.
choice_data_list: I'm glad to see you having fun, Luck.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Speaking of which, Trainer, you were 
totally getting into it too.
choice_data_list:
Because doing comedy routines with you is 
fun.

Because doing comedy routines with you is 
fun.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Yes, yes. Stay healthy, stay healthy.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"To me, Trainer, you are an indispensable, 
top-tier straight man."

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Because Trainer believed in my strength 
and kept playing the fool for me, I can 
keep right on playing the straight man 
forever and ever...

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
...From here on out, I'll leave it up to 
you whether to play the fool or not.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: ――Please continue to be my partner.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Right by my side. I want you to see the 
exact same view as me.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
What kind of joke was made back then? Or 
was it even a joke at all? Whatever it 
was, it was drowned out by the sound of 
the waves.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
However, the retort from the girl standing 
beside me remained as sharp yet warm as 
ever—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In a world glowing crimson at sunset, they 
bloomed in all their vivid splendor.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: ——————"That's enough already."
